blocks.tamil_translation: , and so it has been said,” he will say. Then the judgement will be read out before him, and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hellfire. The third man is a wealthy man; Allah Ta'ala had given him abundant wealth in the world and had also granted him every comfort. He will be brought before Allah Ta'ala. Allah Ta'ala will recount the blessings that were given to him. He will acknowledge them. Allah will ask, “What work did you do for these blessings?” He will say, “In every way in which You told me to spend, I spent the wealth You gave me for Your pleasure.” He will say, “You are lying; you spent so that people would call you generous, and so it has been said.” Then the judgement will be read out before him, and he will be dragged on his face and flung into Jahannam,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ عِلْمًا، مِمَّا يُبْتَغَي بِهِ وَجْهُ اللهِ، لَا يَتَعَلَّمُهُ اِلَّا لِيُصِيْبَ بِهِ عَرَضًا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا، لَمْ يَجِدْ عَرْفَ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَعْنِيْ رِيْحَهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في طلب العلم لغير الله، رقم:٣٦٦٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever acquires Ilm, which should be acquired for the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala, in order to gain the property and wealth of the world, will not be able to breathe even the fragrance of Jannah on the Day of Qiyamah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ يَقُوْلُ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: يَخْرُجُ فِيْ آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ رِجَالٌ يَخْتِلُوْنَ الدّنُيْاَ بِالدِّيْنِ، يَلْبَسُوْنَ لِلنَّاسِ جُلُوْدَ الضَّاْنِ مِنَ
